svg.title: Voltara Divine — Litany of Lightning. Draft 2 / Voltara Divine classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 9 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Anointed by Lightning forks into Dragon's Whispered Wrath then Ethereal Dragon Unbound, or Luminous Conduit then Apotheosis of Thunder. Halo of Static forks into Aegis of Living Light then Unassailable Radiance, or Heaven's Retort. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Voltara Divine jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

Both Lightning strikes carry a 35% self Increase Damage Given row, live the two rounds after the cast and never on its own hit: Bind's is Lightning-elemented and amplifies only Lightning hits, Whispers' lists all four stat types with no element and amplifies every non-pierce hit; the two rows add when both are live and the 15% Lightning Increase Damage Given passive multiplies on top, so self amplification is the bloodline's identity and takes the primary route. The two Highest-stat formula hits (Bind 40 at rank D, cooldown 6; Whispers 50 at rank B, cooldown 7; 60 AP each, single target) are the kit's only direct damage and take the raw-power route. Voltara Blitz's single 30% self Decrease Damage Taken row (all four stat types, realized on the caster at cast, 2 rounds, 60 AP, cooldown 7) is the only defensive lever and the only answer to the bloodline's 10% Wind Increase Damage Taken passive, so it carries the tertiary chain; BUFF","adverse":false,"base":35.0,"gain":0,"final":35.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Unassailable Radiance"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Nine nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on five rows (Increase Damage Given x2, Damage x2, Decrease Damage Taken x1); Blitz's move and pierce and Bind's stun are unsupported. A fourth Advanced Art would need a second capstone on the same rows: a twin of the Damage or amplification route, which opens a second path to that tag's maximum, or a guard capstone past +10. Instead Halo of Static carries one leaf, Heaven's Retort (Damage +2), so the guard root has its own 4 BP build and no node is universal. 12 legal full allocations, 11 non-dominated, every node in at least one.","design_notes":["Node split: 2 Foundations, 4 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts. Anointed by Lightning (IDG +2) forks into Dragon's Whispered Wrath \u2192 Ethereal Dragon Unbound (Damage +2/+3) and Luminous Conduit \u2192 Apotheosis of Thunder (IDG +2, then IDG +3 with DDT +2). Halo of Static (DDT +2, Damage +1) forks into Aegis of Living Light \u2192 Unassailable Radiance (DDT +3, then DDT +5 with Damage +1) and the leaf Heaven's Retort (Damage +2). Advanced Arts are 3 BP deep; two cost 5 BP under one root, 6 across.","Flats by coverage: Damage (two rows) peaks at +6 (Halo 1 + 2 + 3; 46/56), the two-row guardrail; IDG (two self rows) at 2+2+3 = +7 (42% per row), as Lycanthropy and Tenohira Musei; DDT (one row) at 2+3+5 = +10 (30\u219240%). Damage (+2/+3) and guard (+2/+3/+5) reuse Taiyo Kami's Crown of Cinders/Solar Cataclysm and Sunward Oath/Golden Mantle/Sovereign Sun flats; departures: an IDG route where Emberwake sits, +1 Damage secondaries where Taiyo has DDG/IDG (the kit has no DDG, IDT or Afterburn rows).","Interactions: Bind's IDG row carries Lightning and no stat types, so it matches only Lightning damage (the kit's strikes, any Lightning jutsu or weapon), never basic attacks or element-less jutsu. Whispers' IDG and Blitz's DDT have no element and list all four stat types, so they match every non-pierce hit. Each adds power/100 \u00d7 staged base per hit and same-tag rows add (two 42% rows = 84%); only the 15% Lightning passive (bloodline-sourced) multiplies. Pierce, Blitz's included, is untouched.","Timing (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73b): each IDG and DDT row is live the two rounds after its cast, never on its own strike or another action that round. Each cast costs 60 AP, one per round. Bind then Whispers (or the reverse) gives the second strike the first strike's row only (35%, 42% on Tempo); in the one overlap round both strikes are on cooldown (6, 7) and Blitz's hit is pierce, so only a non-kit Lightning hit takes both rows (70%, 84% on Tempo). Blitz's DDT is realized on the caster at cast.","Fourth purchases: Burst (01,02,03) takes Halo of Static (46/56, guard 32%) or Luminous Conduit (45/55, buffs 39%); Tempo (01,04,05) takes Halo of Static (guard 34%, 41/51) or Dragon's Whispered Wrath (42/52, guard 32%); Guard (06,07,08) takes Heaven's Retort (44/54) or Anointed by Lightning (42/52, buffs 37%). With both roots owned, Heaven's Retort and Dragon's Whispered Wrath are interchangeable (01,04,06,09 = 01,02,04,06; 01,06,07,09 = 01,02,06,07), and 01,02,06,09 is dominated by Burst.","Row-weighted value: Tempo (01,02,04,05 and 01,04,05,06) is strongest at 20; Burst, both Guard builds and the all-offence 01,02,03,04 run 18, hybrids 15\u201316. Sea-King's Blessing and Lycanthropy peak at 20 on five rows, Taiyo Kami at 31 on nine. Aegis of Living Light is the lowest-value purchase (3 on one row), the price of the only defensive lever. Value options: IDG route +6 or +5, guard +8, or Retort as Damage +1/IDG +1 (no equal-total pairs, but 01,04,06,09 then trails Tempo)."],"risks":["Classification: Lightning is a basic element on rows of 24 census bloodlines, so the tree needs the proposed bloodline-keyed label; under the current resolver with affectedElements=['Lightning'] only 3 of 5 supported rows match directly, and Whispers' IDG and Blitz's DDT fall back to None, which also reaches every non-elemental row the player casts. Normal-jutsu Lightning collision is unverified.","Broad self amplification (user-owned): Apotheosis of Thunder puts Whispers' IDG at 42% on every non-pierce hit the caster lands for 2 rounds (weapons, basic attacks, normal jutsu) and Bind's at 42% on every Lightning hit, with the 15% Lightning passive multiplying on top; a non-kit Lightning hit in the overlap round adds 84% of staged base. +6 or +5 (Taiyo Kami's two-row figure) are lighter.","Ally-targeted casts: Bind and Whispers (OTHER_USER) accept any living non-caster user in range 4 / 3 (util.ts 2747\u20132749). On an ally the Damage and stun rows (ENEMIES) are withheld but the SELF IDG row is still realized (actions.ts 1060\u20131067), so with an ally present the buff can be taken without landing a strike; uptime is bounded by cooldowns 6/7 and 60 AP, not by enemy range. Not simulated.","Layout (user-visible option): Heaven's Retort is a ninth node added so the guard root has its own 4 BP build and no node sits in every full build. The alternative is Draft 1's eight-node layout, 8 legal full allocations all non-dominated but with Anointed by Lightning in every one; the leaf costs one dominated hybrid (01,02,06,09) and two pairs of equal-total hybrids.","Guard is one row at 2 rounds in 7: Unassailable Radiance puts Blitz's DDT at 40% against every non-pierce hit of any stat type, Wind included, but Blitz is a 60 AP displacement cast (the move row carries the caster in), so the guard also commits position. It stacks with other DDT sources; the bloodline's own 10% Wind IDT passive is unchanged. +8 (capstone +3) is the lighter alternative.","Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt Highest-stat scaling), multiplied by the 15% Lightning passive, with active jutsu buffs adding power/100 \u00d7 staged base, so +6 raw power is not a linear +6 damage; bases are 40 (Bind, rank D) and 50 (Whispers, rank B) on a rank-C bloodline. Each row fires at most once per 6 or 7 rounds; Ethereal Dragon Unbound is the lowest-weight capstone (+3 on two rows).","Unsupported rows and modes: Blitz's move and 56-power pierce and Bind's 100% stun receive nothing, and the pierce is outside every IDG and DDT modifier too; the passives (15% Lightning IDG, 10% Wind IDT) are not jutsu rows. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked PvP / sparring at the pin. No hidden, item-gated, mode-restricted, adverse or hazard supported rows exist in this kit."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":9,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":9,"4":12},"full_budget_allocations":12,"non_dominated_full_allocations":11,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":7,"decreasedamagetaken":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":5,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":2},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 2 / Voltara Divine classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Voltara Divine jutsu inherit Voltara Divine potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":4}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":7,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","02","06","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":7,"decreasedamagetaken":4}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","04","06","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":10}},{"ids":["01","06","07","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["06","07","08","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":4,"decreasedamagetaken":10}}]}

g.text: Draft 2 / Voltara Divine classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Voltara Divine jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Ethereal Dragon Unbound path + Halo of Static
Apotheosis of Thunder path + Halo of Static
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
12 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
